info.title: NVRS Menu API
info.description: API documentation for Node Virtual Restaurant Solutions

item_id.description: The auto-generated id of the menu item

item_name.description: The name of the menu item

price.description: Price as a JSON string (MySQL DECIMAL). Parse with parseFloat before doing arithmetic. Example: "8.00".

dietary_tags.description: Dietary tags, comma-separated when there is more than one (e.g. "vegan, gluten-free")

rating.description: Average rating as a JSON string (MySQL DECIMAL). Example: "4.5".

ingredients.description: Ingredients for this menu item, ordered by name

IngredientDetail.description: One ingredient as prepared within a menu item (rows from menu_item_ingredients joined to ingredients).

ingredient_id.description: The unique identifier of the ingredient

is_allergen.description: Whether this ingredient is a common allergen. Boolean on this endpoint; /ingredients returns 0/1.

quantity.description: Quantity used, as a JSON string (MySQL DECIMAL). Example: "50.00".

unit.description: Unit of measurement (g, ml, each, etc.)

preparation_note.description: How the ingredient is prepared (chopped, minced, shredded, etc.)

is_optional.description: Whether the ingredient can be omitted by request

spice_level.description: Spice level for spicy ingredients (mild, medium, hot)

custom_attributes.description: Additional JSON attributes for ingredient-specific details

Ingredient.description: A row of the ingredient master list (the `ingredients` table).

ingredient_id.description: The unique identifier of the ingredient

is_allergen.description: Whether this ingredient is a common allergen. Returned as 0/1 by this endpoint, unlike /menu/with-ingredients which returns a boolean.

unit_type.description: Default unit family for this ingredient, e.g. "weight" or "volume"

item_id.description: Menu item this nutrition row belongs to

protein.description: Grams of protein as a JSON string (MySQL DECIMAL). Example: "14.5".

fat.description: Grams of fat as a JSON string (MySQL DECIMAL). Example: "24.0".

carbs.description: Grams of carbohydrates as a JSON string (MySQL DECIMAL). Example: "48.0".

Error.description: Error envelope used across the API.

post.summary: Import nutrition data for menu items

500.description: Failed to import menu item ingredients

get.summary: Get image by menu item ID
get.description: Retrieves the most recent image associated with a specific menu item

parameters.name: menuItemId
parameters.description: The ID of the menu item whose image is to be retrieved

404.description: No image found for this menu item

500.description: Server error occurred while retrieving the image

post.summary: Upload an image for a menu item
post.description: Uploads a new image file and associates it with a specific menu item in the database

parameters.name: menuItemId
parameters.description: ID of the menu item to associate with the uploaded image

image.description: The image file to upload (JPEG, PNG, GIF, etc.)

400.description: Bad request - invalid file or menu item ID

post.summary: Upload an image for a menu item (alternative route)
post.description: Alternative endpoint for uploading an image file for a menu item. Functionally identical to '/api/images/menu-item/{menuItemId}'

parameters.name: menuItemId
parameters.description: ID of the menu item to associate with the uploaded image

image.description: The image file to upload (JPEG, PNG, GIF, etc.)

400.description: Bad request - invalid file or menu item ID

get.summary: Get menu item image by image ID
get.description: Retrieves an image from the database by its unique image ID

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the image

404.description: Image not found in the database

500.description: Server error occurred while retrieving the image

delete.summary: Delete a specific image by ID
delete.description: Removes a specific image from the database based on its unique ID

parameters.name: imageId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the image to delete

500.description: Server error occurred while deleting the image

get.description: Retrieves all menu items from the database (basic info only, no ingredients)

get.summary: Get all menu items with ingredients
get.description: Retrieves all menu items with their complete ingredient details nested inside. This is the endpoint the AI consultant consumes for allergen- and macro-aware recommendations.

200.description: A list of menu items with ingredients

get.summary: Get a menu item by ID with its ingredients
get.description: Retrieves a single menu item with its complete ingredient details nested inside

post.description: Adds a new menu item to the database

dietary_tags.description: Comma-separated when more than one, e.g. "vegan, gluten-free"

put.description: Updates an existing menu item in the database

item_name.description: The name of the menu item

example.item_desc: A delicious updated burger with special sauce

delete.description: Deletes a menu item from the database

get.description: Returns every patron without password fields.

get.summary: Get a single patron by ID

post.description: Returns the patron record on success. No token is issued: the session is identified by patron_id thereafter, and no endpoint currently requires an Authorization header.
Validates that the patron exists, then logs a service notification. The staff-facing delivery mechanism is not implemented yet; the call currently succeeds without notifying anyone.

post.summary: Create a Stripe PaymentIntent for a cart
post.description: Recalculates the total from the database, rejects the request if the client-supplied amount differs by more than one cent, creates the PaymentIntent, then writes the order and its line items.

amount.description: Client-calculated total in USD; must match the server total within $0.01

clientSecret.description: Stripe client secret used by Stripe.js to confirm payment

400.description: Missing items, patron_id, or a valid amount

404.description: A cart item does not exist

405.description: Client amount does not match the server-calculated total

get.summary: Get payment status for an order
get.description: Looks up the PaymentIntent at Stripe and joins the local order row.

amount.description: Amount in USD (Stripe cents divided by 100)

post.description: Mounted before express.json() so the raw body survives signature verification. Updates orders on payment_intent.succeeded, payment_intent.payment_failed, and similar events. Configure this URL in the Stripe dashboard; callers are Stripe, not clients.

400.description: Signature verification or event handling failed

get.summary: Redirect to the NVRS web app
get.description: 302 redirect to the currently deployed frontend on Cloud Run. The target is the dev Cloud Run service; update it when production is promoted.
Returns every row of menu_item_nutrition. Macro values (protein, fat, carbs) are MySQL DECIMALs and therefore arrive as JSON strings; only calories is numeric. Join to /menu by item_id.

200.description: A JSON array of macro rows
